card.name: Number after "first" or "top"
card.fires_on: A single digit (3, 4, 5, 6) right after "the first" or "top", before a count noun such as months, weeks, injections, or doses.

modes.description: A digit after "first" counting initial months, weeks, doses, or injections of treatment.
